gen-gf-unica-one-gf-hind-siliguri: Wide-eyed and loud: Unica One leaves daylight in every curve. Hind Siliguri, the sans-serif body, hums along at constant line weight with only a gentle bump up to capitals, so the heading gets the spotlight.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-imperial-aram: Spread-out, ink-tapered and bold: that's Warnes. Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic sits underneath, its c's ends pointing apart and capitals only a short step above lowercase, so the loud heading has no rival.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-khojki: Noto Sans Khojki has exits wide enough to pass light, plus a large, clear eye on every e. And Warnes goes bold with zero stroke contrast and stretched spacing, leaving the sans to keep things open.
